name: Krisztina Hirth
bio: Software engineer for over 20 years, always looking for the right way to deliver reliable, resilient and expandable value through software, knowledge and empathy. As a staff architect at PayFit, I help all teams leverage the benefits of Domain-driven Design by understanding the real problems and discovering the best-fitting models before investing in solutions. I believe that agility is nothing else than feedback-driven development, that DDD and domain modelling reduce the waste of energy, time and future technical debt, and that work must be fun.
